seo_title: A left-bank pizzeria worth the trip from Saryarka
seo_description: Frnds at 25 Sagadat Nurmagambetov Street — the left bank of Astana. Pizza on our own dough, pasta, breakfast any time. Open daily 09:00–23:00.
h1: You live in Saryarka, but business keeps pulling you to the left bank
body:
Life in Saryarka has its own logic. Home, work, the familiar coffee shop around the corner, the Congress Hall where someone once invited you to a conference, Nurly Zhol station when you need to leave town. And yet the left bank keeps drawing you across. A meeting at some department, papers that are faster to hand over in person, a kid asking to go to Khan Shatyr, a get-together whose time and place you didn't pick. So here you are again on this side of the river, lunch has quietly passed you by, and you have no energy left to work out where to eat around here.

We're on the left bank, in the Esil district: 25 Sagadat Nurmagambetov Street. Open every day from 09:00 to 23:00 — no days off, and no break that lands exactly when you arrive. We mix our pizza dough ourselves, and that's not a turn of phrase — it's the reason the crust comes out light instead of rubbery. Beyond pizza there's pasta, panuozzo, soups, salads and desserts. Breakfast is cooked the whole time we're open: if your morning began closer to evening, the kitchen won't argue about it.

If you've dropped in between two errands and your window is exactly long enough to eat — take a panuozzo. It's pizza folded so you can hold it in one hand: no knife, no plate, no settling in. Coffee at the counter, to go. If there's nowhere left to rush and the left bank is done with you for the day, start with soup, then pizza, then dessert, and don't look at the clock. And if you missed the morning entirely — that's exactly what our breakfasts are for, the ones that don't stop at noon. All of it can go in a box to take with you, too.

We're not going to tell you we're worth a special trip across the river. But if the left bank has you anyway — come in. We're here on weekdays when you have things to do, and on weekends when you don't. You can find us on the delivery services as well; they decide their own coverage areas. What goes on in the kitchen is on Instagram, @frnds.kz. And the easiest way to ask something ahead of time or put in a takeaway order is WhatsApp: +7 707 480 92 15.
landmarks: We're in the Esil district, on the left bank — the other side of the river from the middle of Saryarka, Nurly Zhol station and the Congress Hall. The address is simple: 25 Sagadat Nurmagambetov Street.
cta: Come by the next time the left bank calls you over on business — 25 Sagadat Nurmagambetov Street, nine in the morning until eleven at night.
